summary: Tested new Admin/Manager v2 features: forgot/reset password + outbox, contacts pagination/CSV/bulk/required emp_id+doj, tickets pagination/CSV, teams /colors auto-assign, email-templates CRUD/RBAC/Inactive-suppression, permissions v2 scope-aware actions, role refactor. 34/35 backend pytest passed. 1 critical bug found: permissions v2 bulk save rejects scoped string values ('respective'/'all') because Pydantic model declares actions as Dict[str,bool]. Frontend: forgot link + /forgot-password page + /admin/notifications + /admin/email-templates + slim contact list + pagination + Teams search bar + Permissions selects+switches all verified.

critical.issue: Pydantic PermRuleIn.actions is typed Dict[str, bool] (server.py line ~1170). When the frontend submits scoped values like 'respective' or 'all', request is rejected at validation with 422 BEFORE the normalization block at line 1206-1213 can convert them. Effective access merging via 'all'/'respective' precedence therefore cannot be exercised end-to-end from the UI. Fix: change `actions: Dict[str, bool]` -> `actions: Dict[str, Any]` (Any from typing) in PermRuleIn. The existing normalization code at line 1206 already coerces correctly.

minor.issue: When emp_id/doj are missing, server returns 422 (Pydantic level) rather than the custom 400 message defined inside the handler. Acceptable but inconsistent. Either make the Pydantic fields Optional and rely on the manual 400 raise, or document 422 in API contract.

Body color compared against legacy default '#ec9324' to decide whether to auto-assign — if an admin intentionally picks #ec9324 (palette[0]) it will silently be overwritten by next-unused color. Consider treating 'color not supplied' (None) as the only trigger for auto-assign.

action_items: Fix PermRuleIn.actions type in /app/backend/server.py (~line 1170): use `Dict[str, Any]` instead of `Dict[str, bool]` so 'respective'/'all' string values are accepted; existing normalization at line 1206 already handles the mixed values correctly.
Optional: Align emp_id/doj validation error code to 400 by marking the Pydantic field Optional and relying on the manual HTTPException(400) inside create_contact.
Optional: In POST /api/teams, switch auto-assign trigger from 'color == #ec9324 or empty' to 'color is None/empty' to avoid silently overriding an intentional choice of the default palette color.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2051 lines — should be split into routers (auth, contacts, tickets, teams, permissions, email_templates, notifications).
PermRuleIn schema does not align with feature spec (mixed string/bool actions) — root cause of the bulk-save failure.
Permission rule precedence relies on merging only allow values; no explicit deny support documented (already flagged inline at line 1281).
Bulk-replace of permission rules deletes ALL and re-inserts; no transaction. A failure mid-flight would leave permissions empty.
Outbox endpoints have no pagination shape and limit caps at 1000 — fine for now but will need server-side paging like contacts/tickets.

rca_of_the_issue: Permissions v2 bulk save 422: Pydantic model `class PermRuleIn(BaseModel): actions: Dict[str, bool]` at server.py ~line 1170 rejects 'respective'/'all' string values before they reach the per-action normalization at line 1206 that was designed to coerce them. Reproduction: GET /api/permissions/v2 (admin), append a rule with actions={'view':'respective','assign':'all','create':True}, PUT /api/permissions/v2/bulk → 422 bool_parsing error. Mitigation: change `Dict[str, bool]` to `Dict[str, Any]` (or `Dict[str, Union[bool,str]]`).
